name: The Gate Answers  /  The Cage Cracks

description.value:
Once in your entire career — not per day, not per campaign arc, once — the defining act of your faith actually happens, fully, unmistakably.

The Gate Answers

Your prayer is answered directly, from beyond the sealed gates themselves. Effect scale: undo a catastrophe, resurrect several of the dead, banish a Turning-era horror outright. This is table-legend material, built with your GM, not rolled for casually.

The Cage Cracks

You channel a genuine, controlled fragment of Uriel's power through the seal at a target of your choosing — campaign-defining destruction, and the seal is now measurably weaker for it. This should visibly move the setting's main plot (Setting Bible §13) forward.
